paragraphs: Hach sells water analysis products to water quality professionals, a group the company numbers at one million. The lineup includes benchtop spectrophotometers, among them a new DR4900 presented as an update to an older design. Process analyzers include a phosphate model presented as a way to stay compliant.

Instruments are paired with reagents made specifically to work with them. Vial tests carry a barcode that lets the spectrophotometer detect the method on its own, averaging ten readings and rejecting outliers. Those vials measure ammonia, nitrate, phosphate, total chlorine, and more with pre-programmed methods. Another format seals all chemicals and processes inside a single self-contained key for portable analyzers. A recurring order program handles reagents, maintenance kits, and supplies needed on a regular basis.

The chemistry pages cite over 75 years of experience. Vial tests and photometers are described as elements of both process control and compliance monitoring. The homepage notes a Silver Medal from EcoVadis for sustainability efforts.

quote.text: Ensuring water quality for people around the world
